subject: Scale omnichannel CX and self-service for FCR
body:
Hi there,

Salesforce's Q2 FY2026 results show momentum for CX initiatives: 9% growth in the contact center and an 11% rise in Subscription & Support revenue. This progress can underpin scale in omnichannel and self-service programs to improve first contact resolution.

Key moves to consider:
- Momentum from Q2: leverage omnichannel and self-service projects to lift FCR.
- Zero Copy Partner Network: secure, bidirectional integration with Data Cloud to unify experiences across channels.
- Agentforce Agents: AI-powered assistants to boost agent productivity and self-service, with pilot plans to improve FCR in a subset of the contact center.

If you’re open, I’d love to schedule a short call to map a practical pilot aligned with your CX goals this quarter.

Best regards,
ACME AI team
